name: AI Market Simulation Lab
description: AI Market Simulation Lab is a SaaS platform that helps businesses instantly test product ideas, pricing, marketing copy, and features using synthetic AI personas that behave like real customers. Instead of waiting days for surveys or focus groups, companies get instant, data-driven reactions powered by advanced AI models—saving time, money, and guesswork.
key_features:
AI Synthetic Personas
Realistic personas trained to act, think, and respond like real consumers.

Instant Market Feedback
Get immediate reactions on product ideas, pricing, branding, and more.

Persona Libraries
Pre-built personas for students, parents, IT professionals, founders, and niche markets.

Price Sensitivity Testing
See how willingness-to-buy changes across different price points.

Competitor Comparison Mode
Test your product against competing offerings side-by-side.

Sentiment & Emotion Analysis
Understand customer emotions—trust, interest, confusion, hesitation.

Feature Impact Breakdown
Identify which features increase or decrease buying intent.

Real-Time Heatmaps
Visual dashboards showing demand levels and persona reactions at a glance.

Scenario Testing
Test marketing copy, packaging designs, landing pages, product variants, and more.

Exportable Reports
Download insights as PDF or CSV for pitch decks, presentations, or team collaboration.

API Access
Integrate simulations into your product development or research workflows.

Local Model Support
Use cloud LLMs or local models (Ollama) to avoid API limits and reduce cost.
